text: Agent Danmu 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的弹幕插件：它把当前会话里的轮次、步骤、工具调用、重试、上下文压缩和实时 reasoning 片段显示在对话内容区。插件通过 session projection 接收已记录事件，并订阅当前会话的实时片段，在界面浮层中绘制滚动或居中的文字。用户可调整显示区域、密度、速度、字号和透明度，也可重置设置；设置保存在浏览器本机。适合想直观看到 agent 正在处理什么、以及会话状态如何变化的 DSH 用户。安装不需要额外 API key 或外部服务。

Agent Danmu overlays live activity in the DSH web conversation: turns, steps, tool calls, retries, compaction, and reasoning. Adjust speed, size, opacity, area, and density. Settings stay in browser storage; no extra API key or external service is needed.
想在 DSH 对话区看到 agent 每轮处理进度。
能不能把工具调用和模型重试状态显示成滚动弹幕？
我希望实时输出的 reasoning 片段也能在会话里显示。
想知道上下文压缩什么时候开始、结束或失败。
Show live agent activity as an overlay in my DSH conversation.
Can I tune the speed, size, opacity, and screen area of session danmu?
Agent Danmu 的功能「会话活动弹幕」：自动把轮次、步骤、工具调用、模型重试和上下文压缩状态显示在当前对话内容区；实时 reasoning 片段也会分段显示。
Agent Danmu 的功能「弹幕显示控制」：点击输入框旁的弹幕设置按钮，可调整滚动速度、字号、透明度、显示区域和密度，也可一键恢复默认设置。
Agent Danmu 的功能「对话区弹幕布局」：插件测量会话内容区域，并在其中绘制滚动或居中的弹幕；空间不足或速率达到上限时会跳过无法放置的内容。
dsh-plugin-danmu 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 8 天；提交数 37；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-plugin-danmu README · dsh-plugin-danmu：Real-time danmu for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It inserts text such as the agent's reasoning, tool calls and task progress into the conversation area as scrolling text.

Read this in other languages: English | [简体中文](./README.zh.md)

dsh-plugin-danmu README · What is danmu?：Danmu (弹幕) is an interactive mechanism on websites. It first appeared on [ニコニコ動画](https://www.nicovideo.jp) (hereafter NicoNico), where users could display the comments they sent as scrolling subtitles over the page. The mechanism later spread widely in China through [哔哩哔哩](https://www.bilibili.com) (hereafter bilibili), and you can now find it on many video platforms.

dsh-plugin-danmu README · What is danmu?：Notably, the word "弹幕" was originally the Japanese military term "弾幕" (だんまく), commonly translated as "barrage". It refers to a firing method that does not aim precisely and covers the target with a large number of projectiles.

dsh-plugin-danmu README · What is danmu?：As the Chinese internet developed, the word "弹幕" in Chinese has generally come to refer to video danmu, and the distinct term danmu was born from it. The Chinese "弹幕" (danmu) and the Japanese "弾幕" (danmaku) do not have the same meaning, and NicoNico has always called its comments "コメント" (comment).

This project therefore uses danmu as its name, rather than the Japanese romanisation danmaku.

dsh-plugin-danmu README · Installation：You can install it from the dsh plugin manager by entering `dsh-plugin-danmu`. Once installed, the plugin appears in the list as Agent Danmu.

DSH manages dependencies through pnpm, and pnpm's [`minimumReleaseAge`](https://pnpm.io/supply-chain-security) policy skips versions that have not been published for the configured age (at most 24 hours), so installing a plugin may download an older version.

dsh-plugin-danmu README · Installation：To use the latest plugin version immediately, specify the version when installing, for example `dsh-plugin-danmu@^0.3.0`. Alternatively, wait for a while until the new version meets the policy, then install by package name.

dsh-plugin-danmu README · Usage：Once the plugin is installed and enabled, the active danmu region follows the current session and danmu are emitted automatically when the agent starts producing output.

dsh-plugin-danmu README · Usage：Danmu are drawn only inside the conversation content area. They do not cover the session list on the left, the sidebar on the right or the header. The composer and the status bar also sit inside the active region, so danmu pass over them briefly, just like the controls inside the bilibili video frame. The whole layer is click-through, so selecting text or clicking buttons is unaffected.

dsh-plugin-danmu README · Usage：The behaviour matches the bilibili web player in speed, font size, row assignment and how it handles a full content area.

To turn it off, disable the plugin in the plugin manager.

dsh-plugin-danmu README · FAQ：| Question                     | Answer                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| No danmu appears             | Text only appears while you are talking to the agent. If you see none, it proves the whale is not thinking.                                                             |
| Some danmu are missing       | When the content area runs out of room, the text is dropped, the same as bilibili                                                                                       |
| Why are some danmu so long   | bilibili limits each danmu to 100 characters, this project does not. Long lines are split at sentence boundaries, but a single long sentence or a table row stays whole |
| White text in a light theme  | The same style as bilibili, where a black outline keeps it readable

dsh-plugin-danmu README · Icon：The "弹" glyph in the icon is taken from [Lolita](https://www.fonts.net.cn/font-33402852359.html), a free typeface for non-commercial use. The typeface remains under its own licence. The icon is coloured with DeepSeek's theme blue #4D6BFE.
